subject: face, front view, neutral expression, short brown hair (compare the face; the hair is judged separately)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male (Leo)

eye_size.reference: Medium almond eyes, each about a third of the distance from the eyes to the chin wide.
eye_size.ours: Medium almond eyes, each about a third of the distance from the eyes to the chin wide.

eye_spacing.reference: About one and a quarter eye widths between the eyes.
eye_spacing.ours: About one and a quarter eye widths between the eyes.

iris.reference: Green iris, taller than wide, dark green at the top, lighter green at the bottom, dark outline and dark pupil, one white highlight on the right side of the iris.
iris.ours: Green iris, taller than wide, dark green at the top, lighter green at the bottom, dark outline and dark pupil, one white highlight on the right side of the iris.

sclera.reference: Very light, almost white eye whites.
sclera.ours: Very light, almost white eye whites.

lash_line.reference: Dark-brown upper lid line, thicker at the outer corner; the lower lid has only a faint thin line.
lash_line.ours: Dark-brown upper lid line, thicker at the outer corner and wrapping a short way under the outer corner; no other lower line.

brows.reference: Brown brows with darker hair strokes, angled down toward the nose, thick at the inner end and thinner toward the outer end.
brows.ours: Brown brows with darker hair strokes, angled down toward the nose, thin at the inner end, thickest a little way out, thinner toward the outer end.

nose_mouth.reference: Nose shown only as a pale highlight on the bridge and a small pinkish shadow under the tip; thin dark mouth line with a pinkish shadow under the lower lip.
nose_mouth.ours: Nose shown only as a pale highlight on the bridge and a small brown shadow under the tip; thin dark mouth line with a brown shadow under the lower lip.

jaw_chin.reference: Strong jaw narrowing to a short squarish chin.
jaw_chin.ours: Jaw narrowing to a rounded-square chin, slightly narrower and more pointed than the reference's.

ears.reference: Ears partly covered by the side hair, lying close to the head.
ears.ours: Ears partly covered by the side hair, lying close to the head, the left one showing its inner shade.

shading.reference: Two-tone shading: the fringe casts a shadow band on the forehead, a darker warm shadow runs down the far right side of the face and under the jaw; most of the face is flat lit.
shading.ours: Two-tone shading: the fringe casts a few hard shadow patches on the forehead between the clumps; the neck under the jaw and a sliver at the far right of the face are in darker warm shadow; most of the face is flat lit.
